# Write a Comment

This page lets you post a comment to the correct discussion. It uses the `term` query parameter to identify the issue.

<div id="comment-info" style="margin: 12px 0; color: #57606a;"></div>
<div id="giscus-container"></div>
<div id="giscus-error" style="display:none; margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; background: #f6f8fa; color: #24292f;">
  Missing `term` parameter. Go back to an issue page and click “Write a comment”.
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const term = params.get("term") || params.get("pathname");
  const container = document.getElementById("giscus-container");
  const error = document.getElementById("giscus-error");
  const info = document.getElementById("comment-info");

  if (!term) {
    error.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }

  const backHref = term.startsWith("/") ? term : "/" + term;
  info.innerHTML = `Posting to discussion for <a href="${backHref}">${backHref}</a>`;

  const script = document.createElement("script");
  script.src = "https://giscus.app/client.js";
  script.setAttribute("data-repo", "ChanceSiyuan/quarto-lab");
  script.setAttribute("data-repo-id", "R_kgDOREwORA");
  script.setAttribute("data-category", "General");
  script.setAttribute("data-category-id", "DIC_kwDOREwORM4C1teX");
  script.setAttribute("data-mapping", "specific");
  script.setAttribute("data-term", term);
  script.setAttribute("data-reactions-enabled", "1");
  script.setAttribute("data-input-position", "bottom");
  script.setAttribute("data-theme", "preferred_color_scheme");
  script.setAttribute("data-lang", "en");
  script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
  script.async = true;
  container.appendChild(script);
})();
</script>
